Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Class Attribute<T>

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts.Attribute<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the Java type the attribute is read as
public final class Attribute<T> extends Object
Describes an accessor and mutator pair for one model attribute.

This is the Java form of Laravel's Attribute. Instances are immutable: shouldCache() and withoutObjectCaching() return new copies instead of changing the receiver, so one instance can be shared across model instances and threads, provided its getter and setter are.
